meta.title: Indonesian Social Forestry Data Center (PDPSI)
meta.description: Social Forestry approval and designation records from the GoKUPS register, presented as recorded in the source.

common.processed: Processed by PDPSI from the source data; not an official national figure.

footer.about: PDPSI presents Social Forestry approval and designation records from the GoKUPS register as recorded in the source. Data inconsistencies are flagged with a note, never silently corrected.

home.title: Indonesian Social Forestry Data Center
home.lead: Social Forestry approval and designation records from GoKUPS, presented as recorded in the source. See how they are distributed by region, browse each record, and download the data.
home.recordsNote: One record is one row in the GoKUPS register. This is not a count of groups or institutions.
home.areaNote: Sum of the Luas Area Keseluruhan (total area) column across {used} records. {flagged} records carry a note because their total area differs by more than 5 ha from the sum of its components.
home.membersNote: Calculated from {used} records, including those with 0. {notUsedCount, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} could not be calculated ({reasons}).
home.membersCompare: For comparison: the source column Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) sums to {sourceTotal}. In {mismatch} records that column equals the number of women.
home.toStatistics: Statistics by region and PS type

statistics.unitNote: Figures on this page count decree records for approval/designation holders, not groups. Some Hutan Tanaman Rakyat records are individual permits, and some institutions appear under more than one decree number. Hutan Adat (customary forest) is a designation.

download.title: Download data
download.lead: Files for release {version}. Source columns keep their original names and values. Columns prefixed [Olahan PDPSI] and [Pemeriksaan PDPSI] are processed by PDPSI.
download.draftNote: This is a draft release and has not been published as a public release. The data licence has not been specified yet.
download.notRaw: These files are not a complete raw copy: the Ketua Lembaga, Pra-Pendamping, and Pendamping columns are not included.
download.csvNote: CSV files use UTF-8, comma separators, and a dot as decimal mark.

download.rekapNote: The summary Excel file contains national, province, and regency/city sheets (with province subtotals), a long-format sheet for pivoting, and notes.

about.title: About the data
about.fidelityBody: PDPSI does not correct, reconstruct, or estimate source values. Names, numbers, dates, and areas appear as recorded. Empty values are labelled not available, never zero. Records sharing a decree number are not removed, and the seven scheme categories are not merged.
about.sourceBody: The Social Forestry register and decree detail pages in GoKUPS, retrieved {date}. GoKUPS reported {reported} decrees at retrieval time; {rows} rows were retrieved.
about.excludedBody: Ketua Lembaga (chair), Pra-Pendamping, and Pendamping (facilitators) contain personal names. They are not shown until their legal basis, purpose, and privacy risk have been reviewed. The public PDPSI data is therefore not a complete raw copy.

flags.duplicate_sk: Duplicate: the decree number is also used by other records.
flags.duplicate_identical: Record content is identical to another record with the same decree number.
flags.duplicate_attributes_differ: Same decree number as another record, other columns differ.
flags.sk_spacing_variant: Decree number differs from another record only in spacing or letter case.
flags.sk_year_truncated: The year in the decree number has 3 digits.
flags.date_after_extraction: Decree date is later than the data retrieval date.
flags.date_year_mismatch: The year in the decree number differs from the year of the decree date.
flags.area_zero: Total area in the source is 0.
flags.area_component_mismatch: Total area differs by more than 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_component_rounding: Total area differs by 1 to 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_missing: Total area is empty in the source.
flags.area_negative: Total area is negative in the source.
flags.members_total_column_mismatch: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) does not equal men + women.
flags.members_total_equals_female: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) equals the number of women.
flags.members_component_missing: Men or women count is empty in the source.
flags.institution_type_lphd_on_htr: Institution type recorded as Lembaga Pengelola Hutan Desa (village forest institution) under the Hutan Tanaman Rakyat scheme.
flags.kph_bengkulu_utara_outside_bengkulu: Forest management unit recorded as KPHP Bengkulu Utara for a record outside Bengkulu Province; needs confirmation from the GoKUPS operator.
